Service icon source and attribution

Source project: LobeHub / Lobe Icons
Repository: https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons
Pinned commit: c385b2b8d1f9e19aa86e628d4e23c91ee1111a47
Source directory: packages/static-svg/icons/
License: MIT License, Copyright (c) 2023 LobeHub
License text: LICENSE-lobe-icons.txt

Included original SVG files (unmodified):
- codex.svg
- elevenlabs.svg
- openai.svg
- claude.svg
- gemini.svg
- cursor.svg

Each source file has viewBox="0 0 24 24", fill="currentColor", fill-rule="evenodd",
and one path. The application adapts these paths into local WPF drawing geometry
and applies a foreground brush. The SVG files contain no scripts, external
references, images, fonts, filters, or network dependencies.

Pinned source URL format:
https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons/blob/c385b2b8d1f9e19aa86e628d4e23c91ee1111a47/packages/static-svg/icons/{filename}

The marks identify their respective services. Brand names and marks belong to
their respective owners. Inclusion does not imply endorsement or affiliation.
